name: Mitten Extracts | 2g Disposable | Gushers
description: Packed with juicy fruit flavor, Gushers is a hybrid that knows how to keep things balanced. Sweet and bold on the inhale, smooth and mellow on the exhale, this 2g disposable is made for versatility. Whether you’re looking to kick back and relax or keep your head in the game, Gushers is always ready to deliver a consistent, flavorful ride from start to finish.
